annotations.title: Get the links to take a Mappu walk

description: Get the links for taking a Mappu walk: for a published walk, or for the walks at a city or landmark. Use it when the traveler asks how to take a Mappu walk, whether it is free, or what it costs. Returns the free walk or audio-guide page on mappu.ai, which needs no account, and, where Mappu sells it on its own website, the page for a paid two-hour live walk with Mappu, which needs no account either. Says which part is free and which is paid. Nothing is charged in the chat: the paid page opens on mappu.ai, where the price shows before paying.

path.description: Exact public walk or guide path from a previous Mappu result, not a URL.

query.description: The walk, city or landmark, not personal details.
